clue.text: Cow hit on front of head

indicators.note: in an across clue one piece placed on another follows it, so the word for hit comes second

parts.note: the brow is the forehead, the front of the head
to hit is to beat

explanation.surface: A farmer strikes a cow on the forehead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cow' looks like the animal but is the verb meaning to intimidate.
explanation.definitionFit: To cow someone is to intimidate them with bullying words, a verb sense shared by both.

clue.text: Employ again to take top off fruit

indicators.note: taking the top off a down entry removes its first letter, here from the word for the fruit

parts.note: a greengage is a green variety of plum

explanation.surface: Instructions to rehire someone so they can peel the top off a piece of fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take top off' removes the G heading GREENGAGE, a green plum.
explanation.definitionFit: To take on a worker a second time is to hire them once more after a gap.

clue.text: Leave line of verse to mere poet

parts.note: to leave something in a will is to bequeath it, so leave gives will
an iamb is the metrical unit of an iambic line of verse
a mere is a lake or pond

explanation.surface: A dying writer bequeaths a verse to a pond, or to a modest poet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mere' looks like the adjective meaning slight but is the noun for a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: The English visionary author of Songs of Innocence was a celebrated poet and engraver.

clue.text: Add to end of house — namely, with wings

indicators.note: the last letter of the word it picks from

parts.note: the last letter of the word house
sc. abbreviates scilicet, Latin for namely
alate is a botanical and zoological term for winged

explanation.surface: A builder adds an extension to a house with two wings at the end.
explanation.walkthrough: SC (scilicet) is the abbreviation for namely; ALATE means having wings.
explanation.definitionFit: To escalate something is to increase or intensify it, as when one adds to a conflict.

clue.text: Female found in unusual habitat

indicators.note: something unusual is out of the ordinary, so the letters of habitat are set in a new order

explanation.surface: A female animal turns up in a strange habitat.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a girl's given name, so it names a woman.

clue.text: Northern port accessible in October, generally

indicators.note: the run of letters can be reached inside the words October generally, spanning the gap

explanation.surface: A northern harbour that can usually be reached in October.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accessible in' finds the run across octoBER GENerally.
explanation.definitionFit: It is Norway's second city, a seaport on the North Sea coast.

clue.text: Dynasty celebrated in verse

definitions.meaning: the Chinese imperial dynasty of 960 to 1279, also spelt Song
lauded in song or poetry, past participle of a verb for vocal music

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is the Chinese ruling house; the other is the past participle meaning praised in lyrics.

clue.text: Where The Times largely appears to send Jack up

definitions.meaning: a newspaper's title is printed in large type across the top of its front page
a jack tar, a sailor, might be sent aloft to the top of the mast

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a newspaper's title banner; the other is the top of a ship's mast, where a sailor might be sent aloft.

clue.text: States following heartbreak for nymph

indicators.note: the second half of heartbreak tells you to break up the letters of heart

parts.note: USA is the United States

explanation.surface: A nymph whose heart is broken, with America following the story.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue word 'heartbreak' splits: 'break' rearranges HEART into ARETH, followed by USA.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth she was a nymph turned into a spring to escape the river god Alpheus.

clue.text: Carry on business in Kentish Town

definitions.meaning: to trade, to do business
a seaside town on the east coast of Kent, England

explanation.walkthrough: Kentish Town is also a district of London, which is the misdirection; here it means a town in Kent.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is to trade; the other is a seaside town in the county of Kent.

clue.text: Link once with outstanding performer

definitions.meaning: a link was formerly a torch carried to show the way through dark streets
a star or prominent figure in some field

explanation.definitionFit: A torch that guides the way, and figuratively a person who is prominent and influential.

clue.text: Playing essential part? Not 7

definitions.meaning: being a crucial factor in bringing something about
7 down refers to vocal music, and the opposite is music for instruments alone

explanation.definitionFit: It means serving as a means to an end, and also describes music played rather than voiced.

clue.text: Identical articles on CND members in country

parts.note: the separate letters of CND, the Campaign for Nuclear Disarmament
the same indefinite article, a, each time
the separate letters of CND, the Campaign for Nuclear Disarmament
the same indefinite article, a, each time
the separate letters of CND, the Campaign for Nuclear Disarmament
the same indefinite article, a, each time

explanation.surface: Campaigners for nuclear disarmament write identical pieces about a nation.
explanation.walkthrough: Each letter of CND is followed by the article A: C-A, N-A, D-A. CND is Britain's Campaign for Nuclear Disarmament.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the large North American nation north of the United States.

clue.text: Get part after applause that's generous

indicators.note: the word for part comes after the word for applause

parts.note: to give someone a big hand is to applaud them
some means a part or portion

explanation.surface: An actor lands a role after applause, which is big of the director.
explanation.definitionFit: A handsome reward or sum is a generous, ample one.

clue.text: Bonus for strikers due to member's intervention?

definitions.text: Bonus for strikers due to member's intervention?

parts.words: Bonus for strikers due to member's intervention?
parts.note: in cricket, runs scored for the batting side when the ball deflects off a batter's body, a limb or member

explanation.walkthrough: A cricket term: extras scored when the ball hits the batter's pad or leg; 'strikers' are batters, not industrial workers.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket, extras credited to the batting side when the ball glances off a batter's body rather than the bat.

clue.text: Party's bills are amended

definitions.note: read as party is: the political party, taken as its members collectively

indicators.note: amended means altered, so the letters of bills are get rearranged

explanation.surface: A political party's bills have been revised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'amended' rearranges BILLS ARE; 'Party's' is read as 'Party is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Members of the British party descended from the Whigs are known collectively by that name.

clue.text: Proudly displayed what cheerful skipper did

definitions.meaning: to sport something is to wear or show it off
to sport is to frolic or play, as a cheerful child skipping about does

explanation.definitionFit: It means wore with pride, and also frolicked, as a playful child skipping does.

clue.text: Work steadily without large relative, perhaps

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the word for working steadily goes round the others

parts.note: to ply is to work at something steadily
OS is outsize, a clothing size
sib is short for sibling

explanation.surface: Someone works steadily without a large relative's help, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' means outside here: PLY goes round OS (outsize) + SIB.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words express that something may be the case but is uncertain.

clue.text: Atmospheric conditions studied by mathematicians

definitions.meaning: the weather, as in exposed to wind and rain
Euclid's ..., the classic geometry textbook

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is wind and rain; the other is Euclid's famous treatise on geometry.

clue.text: Rodent found in River Thames, oddly

indicators.note: oddly means strangely, so the letters of Thames are mixed up

explanation.surface: A small rodent is spotted in the River Thames, strangely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly' rearranges THAMES into HAMSTE, and R for River goes at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a small burrowing rodent often kept as a pet.

clue.text: Material for coat, except for a girl

parts.note: bar means except, as in all bar one
Thea is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Fabric for a coat, except that a girl has it.
explanation.walkthrough: BAR as a preposition means except.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a fine woollen cloth used for suits and coats.

clue.text: Bully who had a brother in Paris

definitions.meaning: to bully

definitions.text: who had a brother in Paris
definitions.meaning: in Homer, the Trojan hero whose brother was Paris, who abducted Helen

explanation.definitionFit: It means to bully, and names the Trojan champion whose brother Paris abducted Helen.

clue.text: Butler, perhaps, for the old judge

definitions.meaning: ... Butler, the author of Erewhon, an example of a person with this first name
in the Old Testament, the last of the judges of Israel

explanation.definitionFit: It is the first name of the novelist Butler, and of the Old Testament prophet who judged Israel.

clue.text: Reaction about some of the players

parts.note: re means about or concerning
the percussion section is one group of players in an orchestra

explanation.surface: A reaction regarding some orchestra members.
explanation.definitionFit: A consequence or effect produced in response to an event.

clue.text: Combine for American game

definitions.meaning: to put resources together into a common fund
pocket billiards as played in America

explanation.definitionFit: It means to put resources together, and is the American form of billiards.

clue.text: Stylish liners sailed thus for the Blue Riband

definitions.meaning: an informal word for fashionable or high-class

definitions.text: liners sailed thus for the Blue Riband
definitions.meaning: transatlantic liners chasing the record sailed ..., New York

explanation.walkthrough: The Blue Riband was the award for the fastest Atlantic crossing; liners raced to NY.
explanation.definitionFit: It means fashionable, and read as two pieces, to New York, the westbound route of record-breaking liners.

clue.text: Legal ambiguity providing opening in Old Bailey?

definitions.meaning: a gap in a law that lets people evade it
a bailey is the outer wall of a castle, and a narrow slit in such a wall let archers shoot out

explanation.walkthrough: The Old Bailey is London's central criminal court, which suggests law; but a bailey is also a castle's outer wall.
explanation.definitionFit: It means a gap in the law, and literally an arrow slit in a castle wall.

clue.text: Solitary revolutionary on side of monarch

indicators.note: a revolutionary overturns things, so the letters of solitary are turned around into a new order

explanation.surface: A lone rebel sides with the king.
explanation.definitionFit: A supporter of the crown backs the king or queen, especially in a civil war.
